gemini.rationale: The slice documents that the company had 'no further material business operations' and was winding down its remaining assets immediately after the sale. Consequently, there is no evidence of product/process (p4) or process/organization (p5) integration disruption, as the entity ceased operations and SEC reporting.

grok.performance_metric: terminal wind-down; no material operations; ceased SEC reporting
grok.rationale: The slice documents only the registrant's immediate post-close terminal state (no further material business operations; wind-down of remaining assets; full board/officer resignations save one; cessation of all SEC reporting after the April 1, 2016 8-K), with explicitly no public periodic record for the ~2019-2021 window. No realized disruption at the product/process interface or process/organization interface is described over time, so both pathways code 0 (none documented).

openai.performance_metric: No further material business operations immediately after closing
openai.rationale: The registrant reported immediately after closing that it had no further material business operations and was evaluating a wind-down of its remaining assets. Although all but one director and officer resigned, the slice does not document an operating-integration breakdown between processes and the organization, nor any product/process incoherence over time. No periodic public record exists for 2019-2021 that documents either pathway.
